title: isodon umbrosus var. excisinflexus
intro: Isodon umbrosus var. excisinflexus, commonly known as Chinese mountain mint, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. Its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Isodon umbrosus var. excisinflexus include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-bacterial effects.
